__comment: The robot item is the entity's own cube: an 8x8x8 box centred in the model space, wrapped in the same 32x32 skin net RenderRobot uses. The uv numbers are model-space 0..16 units over a 32px texture, i.e. exactly half the texel coordinates in RenderRobot.UVS. Texture is the textures/item/ copy of robot_base.png so it lands on a listed atlas source (entity textures are bound as whole files and are not stitched).
